links_touching_record.rationale: The AFE design record's interfaces field is a signal table: it names cell_voltages as uint16_t[] in mV at 20 Hz and says nothing about who calls it, what the legal string range is or how a failure is reported. FB2-SW-IFS-000001 replaces that table with the six declared elements of the API, their real signatures, the assertion that bounds the string argument, the two-value return contract and the 1 ms period the calling task imposes. It refines FB2-SW-DSN-000001, the architecture record whose signal table it supersedes, and is at the same level as FB2-SW-DSN-000004, the detailed design record for the same element: it adds the interface contract that the detailed design record also does not carry.

FB2-SW-SIR-000001 is the software interface requirement set for the acquisition and monitoring boundary and is specified by FB2-SW-IFS-000001 (AFE measurement driver API) and FB2-SW-IFS-000002 (SOA supervision). The direction is specification to requirement, which is the direction a requirement is written in: the interface specification establishes what the interface is by analysing the source at the pinned commit, and the requirement states what must be true of it. This is the opposite of the direction the three existing FB2-SW-SWR-* requirements were produced in - those are back-inferred from the implementation and their revision history says so - and naming the relationship explicitly is what keeps the two directions distinguishable. Every statement in the requirement is traceable to a named element of the specification, and the requirement carries that traceability as a field rather than leaving it in prose.

No interrupt context reaches this entry point in the source.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: None recorded at this entry point. Each backend's own implementation would have to carry its own.

error_paths.observed_behaviour: The return value is discarded: the body of MEAS_Control is a single call statement with no assignment and no test.

not_specified_by_source: The documentation comment for AFE_TriggerIc records no @return, so the header does not say what the return value means; the two-value enum is the only contract available.

Which backend implementation is active is not stated by this interface. Seven implementations share the name AFE_TriggerIc, one per AFE family, and the selection is a build-time decision this record does not resolve.
The period is stated by the caller, not by this interface. The header carries no period, no deadline and no budget.
Whether the backend is re-entrant safe, and whether AFE_TriggerIc may be called from more than one context, are not specified anywhere in the interface.

return_contract.evidence: src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85 declares typedef enum { STD_OK, STD_NOT_OK } STD_RETURN_TYPE_e;

values.STD_OK: The request was accepted by the AFE state machine.

timing.evidence: The source imposes the period, not this record. MEAS_Control is documented at src/app/driver/meas/meas.h L76-L83 as 'called every 1ms from the tasks'; it calls AFE_TriggerIc at src/app/driver/meas/meas.c L80-L82; MEAS_Control is called from FTSK_RunUserCodeCyclic1ms at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.c L253; and FTSK_TASK_CYCLIC_1MS_CYCLE_TIME is 1u at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.h L94.

validity_signalling.evidence: The declaration at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L108 returns STD_RETURN_TYPE_e, so a caller that reads the return value can see a rejection.

concurrency.evidence: Reached only from FTSK_InitializeUserCodePreCyclicTasks at src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.c L230, which the source comments as running before the operating system is started, so no interrupt can race it.
concurrency.protection_mechanism: None recorded. The pre-cyclic start-up context is the constraint, and it is a comment in the source rather than an enforced precondition.

validity_signalling.evidence: The declaration at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L111 returns STD_RETURN_TYPE_e.

concurrency.evidence: Called from src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L426, which runs in the state-machine trigger, not in an interrupt context in the source.

error_paths.condition: The measurement start request is rejected.
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The value is discarded: the caller writes (void)MEAS_StartMeasurement() at src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L426.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state what 'measurement started' means in observable terms, such as which output changes or which flag a consumer may poll.

No completion or timeout is offered. A caller cannot learn that the first cycle finished from this call; it must call AFE_IsFirstMeasurementCycleFinished instead, and the relation between the two is not stated here.
Whether a second call while a measurement is in progress is accepted, rejected or idempotent is not specified.

return_contract.evidence: src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85 declares typedef enum { STD_OK, STD_NOT_OK } STD_RETURN_TYPE_e;

values.STD_OK: The request was accepted by the AFE state machine.

timing.evidence: Called once per start-up sequence by the system state machine: (void)MEAS_StartMeasurement() at src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L426, and MEAS_StartMeasurement forwards to AFE_StartMeasurement at src/app/driver/meas/meas.c L108-L110. It is not called periodically.

validity_signalling.evidence: The declaration at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L124 returns STD_RETURN_TYPE_e.

concurrency.evidence: Reached through MEAS_RequestTemperatureRead, which is a task-level wrapper; no interrupt path to it appears in the source.

error_paths.condition: string is at or above BS_NR_OF_STRINGS.
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The wrapper trips a precondition assertion before the request reaches the driver.
error_paths.signalled_as: precondition assertion, not a returned error

error_paths.condition: The request is rejected by the AFE state machine.
error_paths.evidence: The return type is STD_RETURN_TYPE_e at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L131.
error_paths.observed_behaviour: STD_NOT_OK is returned to the wrapper's caller.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state the unit or the valid range of the temperature it causes to be read. Nothing here gives a temperature scale, a resolution or a valid window.
The interface does not state how a caller obtains the temperature once the request has been accepted, or how it distinguishes a stale reading from a fresh one.
No completion notification is offered; the function returns before the measurement exists, and the mechanism a caller would use to learn completion is not named by this interface.

parameters.meaning: Identifies which battery string the request addresses, because the module serves more than one string.
parameters.name: string
parameters.range_evidence: The forwarding wrapper asserts it: FAS_ASSERT(string < BS_NR_OF_STRINGS) at src/app/driver/meas/meas.c L85. BS_NR_OF_STRINGS is (1u) at src/app/application/config/battery_system_cfg.h L109.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: No third value exists. STD_RETURN_TYPE_e is a two-value enum declared at src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85, so a caller cannot distinguish 'not yet ready' from 'rejected'.
return_contract.evidence: src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85 declares typedef enum { STD_OK, STD_NOT_OK } STD_RETURN_TYPE_e;

values.STD_OK: The request was accepted by the AFE state machine.

timing.evidence: Requested on demand by consumers, not on a fixed period. The open-wire period that the interface itself fixes is a different request: AFE_ERROR_OPEN_WIRE_PERIOD_ms is (30000u) at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L99.

validity_signalling.evidence: The return value carries the request outcome; the argument range is enforced one level up by an assertion rather than by a returned error.
validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value for the request, and a precondition assertion for the argument.

concurrency.evidence: Called from src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L432; no interrupt path to it appears in the source.

error_paths.condition: The first cycle has not been made.
error_paths.evidence: src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L432 compares the result against true.
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns false and the caller keeps waiting.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not say whether the flag latches or whether it can return to false. A caller reading 'first cycle finished' would assume a latch, and the source does not state one.
The interface does not say how long the first cycle takes, so a caller cannot distinguish 'not finished yet' from 'never going to finish'.
No error state exists. A backend that failed to start a measurement has no way to express that through this element.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: The declared false state is the safe direction: before the first cycle the function reports that the cycle has not finished. It cannot report a third condition.
return_contract.evidence: Declared with a doxygen @return of 'true is the first measurement cycle was made, false otherwise' at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L113-L117.

values.false: The first measurement cycle has not been made yet.
values.true: The first measurement cycle was made.

timing.evidence: Polled by the system state machine at src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L432, guarded by a comparison against true, inside the state-machine trigger rather than on a fixed period.

validity_signalling.evidence: The declaration returns bool, so the caller can distinguish the two states.

concurrency.evidence: Reached from an asynchronous CAN transmit callback body at src/app/driver/can/cbs/tx-async/can_cbs_tx_f_debug-identify-hardware.c L189; the source shows no critical section around the read.

error_paths.condition: The caller dereferences the returned pointer.
error_paths.evidence: The declared return type at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L172 is a pointer into driver state, and no copy or snapshot is documented.
error_paths.observed_behaviour: The pointer is into the driver's own state structure, so the data read is whatever the driver currently holds.

not_specified_by_source: The interface does not state how many serial identifiers there are, so the caller cannot know how far to read from the returned pointer without a separate agreement.
The interface does not state whether the pointed-to data is stable, whether it changes under the caller, or how long it remains valid.
No lock, no ownership rule and no lifetime rule are stated. The source hands out a pointer into internal state and says nothing about it.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: Undocumented. The doxygen comment names only the success case: 'pointer to the first serialId of the serialId field in driver state structure'. Nothing states when the pointer is invalid.
return_contract.evidence: Declared at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L169-L172 with the comment 'pointer to the first serialId of the serialId field in driver state structure'.

values.NULL_PTR: Not stated. The source does not document a null return for this function, so a caller has no documented contract for it.
values.non-NULL: A pointer to the first serialId of the serialId field of the driver state structure.

timing.evidence: Not called periodically. The one caller in the source is the asynchronous CAN debug transmitter, which reads the pointer at src/app/driver/can/cbs/tx-async/can_cbs_tx_f_debug-identify-hardware.c L189.

validity_signalling.evidence: The declaration returns uint64_t * at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L172 and the only documented behaviour is a non-null pointer into the driver state structure. No failure value is documented, so a caller cannot observe failure from this element.
validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value is a pointer into driver-internal state.

interface_level_gaps.consequence: A requirement written against this interface is a requirement against seven implementations that this corpus has not compared with each other.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: Seven files define AFE_TriggerIc: src/app/driver/afe/adi/common/ades183x/api/adi_ades183x_afe.c, src/app/driver/afe/debug/can/api/debug_can_afe.c, src/app/driver/afe/debug/default/api/debug_default_afe.c, src/app/driver/afe/ltc/api/ltc_afe.c, src/app/driver/afe/maxim/api/mxm_afe.c, src/app/driver/afe/nxp/api/nxp_afe.c and src/app/driver/afe/ti/api/ti_afe.c.
interface_level_gaps.gap: The interface is a family of seven implementations behind one header, and nothing in the interface says which one is active or whether a consumer may rely on behaviour common to all seven.

interface_level_gaps.consequence: For AFE_TriggerIc, AFE_Initialize and AFE_StartMeasurement the interface can signal failure but the code that calls it does not observe it, so a failure of any of the three is invisible at the call site. This is a finding about the implementation, not a defect asserted against it.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: src/app/driver/meas/meas.c L80-L82 discards the AFE_TriggerIc result; src/app/task/config/ftask_cfg.c L230 writes (void)MEAS_Initialize(); src/app/engine/sys/sys.c L426 writes (void)MEAS_StartMeasurement().
interface_level_gaps.gap: Three of the six elements have a return value that the only caller in the source discards.

interface_level_gaps.consequence: Nothing here can be traced to the hardware that would have to satisfy it. The hardware interface that would carry those limits is FB2-HW-HDD-000001's subject and that record says the schematics are unavailable.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: The header declares only the request vocabulary AFE_REQUEST_e at src/app/driver/afe/api/afe.h L68-L73 and two constants, AFE_ERROR_OPEN_WIRE_PERIOD_ms and AFE_DEFAULT_CELL_VOLTAGE_INVALID_VALUE, at L99 and L102; neither is an accuracy or range statement.
interface_level_gaps.gap: No element of this interface carries a physical or electrical contract: no cell count, no sense range, no accuracy, no sampling time.

providing_module.name: AFE driver, backend-selected
providing_module.note: Seven files define a function of the same name for this API - under the adi, debug, debug/default, ltc, maxim, nxp and ti families - so the interface is a family of implementations behind one header rather than one implementation. Which one is compiled is a build-time decision this record does not resolve.
providing_module.role: Provides the measurement interface for the battery strings. Seven backends implement the same entry points, one per AFE family, and the header is the single API all of them present.

revision_history.description: First interface specification in this corpus. Six elements of the AFE measurement API, each with its declaration transcribed from the header at the pinned commit and checked against the source line it cites, its argument range read from the assertion that enforces it, its return values read from the enum the source defines, and its timing read from the task configuration that calls it.

standards_mappings.rationale: Names the providing and consuming modules, the real signatures, the argument ranges, the validity signalling read off the real error paths, and the timing and concurrency the source imposes. It does not carry a protocol or an ownership rule, and no interface agreement exists.

verification_status.statement: The contract above was read from the source at the pinned commit and has not been compared with what the code does when it runs.
